method: Actual terminal UI section and handlers executed in a minimal Node VM DOM fixture. Does not validate browser event timing, visual position or rendering; live CUA verification required.

tests.name: click preserves tab DOM for double click; inline rename Enter and Escape retain focus
renaming on blur does not rebuild neighbouring tabs or lose the next click
shell menu is nonmodal and choosing a shell keeps custom name and command draft
shell menu supports arrow navigation, Escape, outside click and listener cleanup
tabs keep individual shells and drafts; adding opens the dock and copies selected shell
project switch closes shell menu, isolates state and preserves state on project rename
closing inactive tab keeps active tab; closing last allows shell selector to create a new tab
